title: Kadaharan Anu Teu Disangka-sangka Ti Si Sepuh
intro: Di tempat suci Baitullah, saurang abdi Allah anu parantos sepuh ngalaman misteri anu jero anu ngaleuwihan sadaya harepan. Jalmi anu satia ieu, anu parantos lami janten kolot, nyaksian hal anu luar biasa anu ngungkabkeun rahmat Ilahi anu teu aya watesna. Teka-teki na aya dina ngungkabkeun momen anu hilap ieu tina kahirupan para nabi.
clues: Umat ​​kuring katelah Israil, turunan ti saurang bapa leluhur anu agung di jaman baheula.
Peuting-peuting kuring ngadoa, sujud ka payuneun Gusti kuring di kuil.
Abdi dipaparin putra nalika sepuh, hiji anugrah anu teu eureun-eureun abdi ngagungkeun Allah.
Uji coba kuring nyaéta mendakan rezeki anu muncul pikeun jiwa ngora anu aya dina asuhan kuring.
Abdi téh saurang nabi nu namina Zakariyya, anu dibéré tugas pikeun ngurus Maryam di Bayt al-Maqdis.
Jawabanana aya dina ayat dimana Allah nampi Maryam sareng masihan rezeki ka anjeunna.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
